feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 14 November 2026 10:15pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 14 November 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure west of Ireland tracking eastwards, bringing frontal systems over the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, though a force lower in the southeast of the area. Decreasing south or southeast 4 or 5 in all waters overnight. Then becoming northwest 6 or 7 later tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, decreasing slight or moderate for a time tomorrow morning and early afternoon.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then rain arriving overnight. Clearing to isolated showers tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers or rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest 6 or 7, gradually decreasing 4 or 5 overnight into Monday. Becoming variable 3 or less Monday morning, then becoming east or southeast Monday afternoon, then gradually increasing 6 to gale 8 by end of period.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, occasionally rough in the south at first, decreasing slight by Monday morning. Then increasing moderate or rough early Monday night.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
